meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides the Silktide cookie bar, AdSense blocks, featured slideshow and footer on Public Domain Movies; blur or hide posters.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on publicdomainmovie.net/. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (Chrome and the network were out of memory on this machine), movie detail pages, genre pages. The site is Drupal and not responsive-split, so the same selectors are expected on phones. [INFERRED]

LIVE counts on Home: silktide-bar desktop home 2; adsense-auto desktop home 3; teaser-slideshow desktop home 1; posters-blur desktop home 9; posters-hide desktop home 9; footer desktop home 1. Existing cookie rule now also lists `.cc_banner-wrapper, .cc_banner` (Silktide cookie bar, Got it button) and the ad rule `.google-auto-placed, .advert-leaderboard2, .modal-ad` (AdSense auto-placed wrapper that `ins.adsbygoogle` sits in, plus the off-screen native-ad box).

Choice: Movie posters Show/Blur/Hide (blur 10px). `.cover_image` is a readable Drupal Views class, not hashed.

NOT verified: detail pages (embedded player, comments), phone layout, whether AdSense serves different slots per visit.
